entries.04b614bbb7a20dcb: IoT Engineering Services surpassed Mobile Engineering Services to become the largest service category. While the mobile field declined as telecommunications carriers scaled back 5G area roll-out construction, demand for labor-saving and digitalization on site, driven by labor shortages, has led installation projects for smart meters and various IoT devices to drive growth in the IoT field. Sales are concentrated among major customers, and SoftBank Corp. accounts for 18.2% of net sales.
entries.195dc27b69f05150: As its Infratech Business, it provides Mobile Engineering Services, IoT Engineering Services, and other services (support in the IT infrastructure field, RPA, sales of 'BLAS', and others).
entries.19d7f0c9de17cdc7: Net sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥8,427 million, up 5.5% from the previous fiscal year. By service category, IoT Engineering Services were ¥3,742 million, Mobile Engineering Services ¥3,252 million, and other services ¥1,431 million.
entries.226c1840f28eafc9: Companies requiring support in the IT infrastructure area or introduction of RPA
entries.28c9dfe82af839ce: Drawing on know-how developed in field operations for both mobile and IoT services, this service provides engineering in the IT infrastructure area, such as servers and networks, sells RPA tools, provides RPA implementation support, and sells “BLAS” to external customers.
entries.3e25e87911dc0be7: A company that designs, builds, operates and maintains communications infrastructure and IoT equipment for infrastructure operators such as telecommunications, electric power and gas, and also provides a cloud service that makes fieldwork more efficient.
entries.4115bb172f3f81c1: For the fiscal year ended June 2026, it recorded net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥112 million.
entries.41d75c5bc03919d4: This service builds, operates and maintains IoT infrastructure and networks.
entries.4378db9f20627b2b: This service builds, operates and maintains mobile phone infrastructure and networks. It provides area design, siting and construction of base stations, integration that enables base stations to transmit radio waves, and operation monitoring and maintenance; its strength lies in project support work carried out resident at clients' sites. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,252 million.
entries.59cb10ce4181b1f4: Its strength lies in advancing automation and efficiency in site management, work and project management by combining its in-house on-site work DX cloud 'BLAS' with AI (image recognition) and RPA. With bases in major cities in Japan and a network of 545 partner companies, 'Basis Partners', it has a structure to handle nationwide projects, and in the mobile field it has built up a track record of on-site project support and of supporting radio equipment regardless of telecommunications carrier.
entries.59f69f362d691a2f: This is a single-segment business, conducted by the company and one consolidated subsidiary (Avanse Ajiru Co., Ltd.), that provides design, construction, operation and maintenance of telecommunications and IoT infrastructure, along with various project support services, to infrastructure operators such as telecommunications, electric power and gas companies. Combining its know-how in building telecommunications infrastructure with its in-house developed field-work DX cloud “BLAS” as well as AI and RPA, it provides field operations outsourcing (BPO) and SaaS in an integrated manner under the form of “BPaaS,” delivering end-to-end service from infrastructure construction through operation and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥8,427 million.
entries.5e8fb08ea1c1bfce: Fees for contracted projects such as base station construction
entries.6c08385298f4c894: Engineering in the IT infrastructure field
entries.7c55731ac6d54cae: The Related Information section of the Segment Information section states net sales to external customers of ¥3,742 million for IoT Engineering Services and ¥3,252 million for Mobile Engineering Services, and, as information by major customer, SoftBank Corp.'s share of net sales of 18.2%. The analysis of operating results states the reduction in 5G area roll-out construction and the expansion of IoT device installation projects.
entries.8193190b37644919: Its customers are mainly telecommunications carriers, along with operators of living infrastructure such as electric power and gas, telecommunications equipment manufacturers, and operators of facilities such as railways, parking lots and retail stores. Its major customers include SoftBank Corp., SB Engineering Co., Ltd., and TEPCO Power Grid, Inc.
entries.8668099de132a0aa: Fees for on-site project support and for operation monitoring and maintenance
entries.8a4a204358bfe19c: It has set out its MISSION, 'Create the foundations of society and support the future and happiness of people and society,' and its VISION, 'Update The World～Change, drive change, and become an indispensable Only One,' and aims, toward 2035, to 'Win on value, not scale. Become a company that leads the industry.' The Medium-Term Management Plan 2030, formulated in August 2026, sets as its basic policy the building and expansion of an 'Infratech Platform', with the expansion of BPaaS, which combines the outsourcing of on-site operations with SaaS, as its growth engine. Its 5 key strategies are: expanding the areas it covers; expanding sales of BLAS and converting it to BPaaS; transforming the management foundation through company-wide AX; branding and marketing; and M&A.

entries.b8d906cc89c5cd58: Basis Corporation is a company with its head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. It has 1 consolidated subsidiary, and the number of consolidated employees as of June 30, 2026 was 560.

Revenue from the staffing business of consolidated subsidiary Avanse Ajiru Co., Ltd. is also included in this category. entries.c9324d8dc585db31: The Business Overview section states as strengths the efficiency gained through the company-developed 'BLAS' and the use of AI and RPA, a nationwide support structure through its bases and partner network, on-site project support, and a track record of supporting radio equipment regardless of telecommunications carrier.

Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,742 million, the largest of the service categories.
